site.name: Good Friday Mine
site.location: North Boulder Creek / Boulder Falls area
overview: Good Friday Mine was a documented tungsten mine east of North Boulder Creek near Boulder Falls, developed by multiple tunnels and shafts within the Boulder County tungsten district.

timeline.text: Federal mining records describe the property as chiefly accessible through the April Fool shaft and the lowest tunnel during this period.
Records identify Star Tungsten Corporation ownership and leasing by H. R. Meyer with subleases during the later operating period.

moreHistory: U.S. Geological Survey reporting describes Good Friday as a highly productive tungsten property while noting that the early production record is incomplete.
Federal mapping preserves the mine locality at approximately 40.006653, -105.40305. The point identifies the historic mine area without claiming that a surviving opening has been field-surveyed.
